title: GPS lost
injected: SIM_GPS1_ENABLE = 0 (the GPS stops giving a fix)
expected: EKF failsafe: without GPS it can't hold position, so it lands where it is (FS_EKF_ACTION = LAND)
observed: switched to LAND after 8.0 s; landed 24.5 m from home (5.0 m from where the fault hit); drifted 5.0 m (true position).
events: EKF Failsafe: changed to Land Mode

title: GPS glitch (100 m, 3 s)
injected: SIM_GPS1_GLTCH_X = 0.0009° (GPS suddenly reports 100 m north) for 3 s
expected: EKF rejects the jump (it disagrees with the IMU by far more than its gate) and the drone stays put
observed: kept flying: at most 0.1 m from its hover point (limit 3 m), belief vs truth at most 0.0 m; no failsafe needed.

title: GPS spoofing (steady 20 m offset)
injected: SIM_GPS1_GLTCH_X = 0.00018° (GPS reports 20 m north) for 15 s
expected: Known weakness: a steady offset looks like real movement, so the EKF believes it and the drone REALLY moves ~20 m south (only big or brief jumps are rejected: EK3_GLITCH_RAD = 25 m)
observed: believed the false GPS: really flew 20.5 m away from its hover point while its belief was off by up to 20.3 m, then came back when the offset ended.

title: Weak motor (80 % thrust)
expected: The attitude controller works the other motors harder and it keeps holding position (at 60 % it sinks: hovering already needs ~59 % throttle, so there's no margin left)
observed: kept flying: at most 1.1 m from its hover point (limit 3 m), belief vs truth at most 0.1 m; no failsafe needed.

title: Motor dead (quad)
expected: Physics: a quad can't fly on 3 motors (it can't balance roll, pitch AND yaw), so it falls
observed: fell out of the sky: hit the ground 1.7 s after the motor stopped, at 10.7 m/s.

title: Motor dead (hexa)
injected: SIM_ENGINE_FAIL = motor 1, SIM_ENGINE_MUL = 0 on a 6-motor '+' hexacopter
expected: With DEFAULT settings a hexa buys time (it stays up several seconds) but loses heading control and can't hold position; ArduCopter reports 'Potential Thrust Loss' and its crash check disarms
observed: stayed in the air 19.9 s (a quad: under 2 s) but could not hold position: swung up to 28 m away while losing heading control.

title: Radio link lost
injected: SIM_RC_FAIL = 1 (no signal from the pilot's transmitter)
expected: Radio failsafe (FS_THR_ENABLE = 1): return to launch and land at home
observed: switched to RTL after 1.1 s; landed 0.0 m from home (20.0 m from where the fault hit).

title: Battery low
expected: Battery failsafe (BATT_FS_LOW_ACT = RTL): after 10 s below the limit, fly home and land
observed: switched to RTL after 10.2 s; landed 0.0 m from home (20.0 m from where the fault hit).

title: Strong gusty wind
injected: SIM_WIND_SPD = 10 m/s from the west, SIM_WIND_TURB = 2
expected: It leans into the wind and still holds position within a couple of metres
observed: kept flying: at most 0.4 m from its hover point (limit 3 m), belief vs truth at most 0.1 m; no failsafe needed.

title: Compass failure
expected: It switches to its second compass and keeps flying normally
observed: kept flying: at most 0.1 m from its hover point (limit 3 m), belief vs truth at most 0.0 m; no failsafe needed.

title: Geofence breach
injected: FENCE_ENABLE = 1, 40 m circle, fence avoidance off (AVOID_ENABLE = 0); 'fly to 70 m north', then push north at 4 m/s
expected: Layer 1: GUIDED refuses a destination outside the fence. Layer 3: once really outside, the breach triggers RTL and it lands at home. (Layer 2, avoidance, is switched off here: with defaults it brakes at the edge; we measured it stopping at 40.6 m)
observed: 'fly to 70 m north' was refused (it didn't move); pushed north at 4 m/s instead, it got 44.9 m from home (fence 40 m), switched to RTL after 8.4 s; landed 0.0 m from home (20.0 m from where the fault hit).
